AgentRunListItemResponseDto.description:
Actual persisted latest execution association, not a runtime-health claim.

DEV_FAKE is a development simulation; CONFIGURATION only identifies the binding source.
AgentRunListItemResponseDto.title: AgentRunListItemResponseDto

AgentRunListResponseDto.description: Workspace/state-scoped, descending createdAt/id page. No execution side effects.
AgentRunListResponseDto.title: AgentRunListResponseDto

AttemptControlRequestDto.description: Control has no client-supplied actor or command payload.
AttemptControlRequestDto.title: AttemptControlRequestDto

BasicTextObservationDto.description: Bounded basic-text observations; no response text is stored.
BasicTextObservationDto.title: BasicTextObservationDto

ConnectionCheckDto.description:
SUCCEEDED has a kind-specific, limited meaning.

BASIC_TEXT proves one complete basic text response. STREAM_TEXT proves valid text
increments, normal completion and the final completion marker. STREAM_STOP proves
text was observed and the local response stream/client were closed; Provider-side
cancellation and stopped billing remain unconfirmed. THINKING proves nonblank dedicated
reasoning, a complete answer and normal stream completion with local cleanup; it does not
assess reasoning quality. THINKING_SIGNAL_MISSING means only that this complete response
contained no dedicated reasoning signal, not that the model lacks thinking support.
SEARCH_SOURCES proves completed native search calls, structured sanitized source references
and a complete answer with local cleanup. It does not prove source accuracy, answer-to-source
citation binding, remote search termination or billing limits. No kind activates a candidate.

UNKNOWN may have executed and incurred Provider charges; never automatically resubmit.
currentness is recomputed from the current candidate and non-secret connection/probe versions.
ConnectionCheckDto.title: ConnectionCheckDto

ConnectionCheckInputDto.description: Frozen non-secret input. inputDigest identifies the fixed probe and configuration.
ConnectionCheckInputDto.title: ConnectionCheckInputDto

ConnectionCheckReceiptDto.description:
Historical admission receipt. Poll this check ID.

Receipt revision is not a candidate revision.
ConnectionCheckReceiptDto.title: ConnectionCheckReceiptDto

ConnectionCheckUsageDto.description: Only actual returned token metadata; missing values are unknown, not zero or free.
ConnectionCheckUsageDto.title: ConnectionCheckUsageDto

CreateMaterialSourceCheckRequestDto.description: Select exactly one immutable dossier material. No path, URL, hash or result input.
CreateMaterialSourceCheckRequestDto.title: CreateMaterialSourceCheckRequestDto

CreateModelDeploymentRequestDto.description:
Unverified candidate only.

connectionRef accepts model-connection:<identifier>, never credentials or a URL.
CreateModelDeploymentRequestDto.title: CreateModelDeploymentRequestDto

CreateValidationDossierRequestDto.description:
At least one material/check. Maximum raw HTTP body: 65536 bytes.

Caller hashes are declarations. Only exact same-revision terminal checks are accepted.
CreateValidationDossierRequestDto.title: CreateValidationDossierRequestDto

DeclaredDossierMaterialDto.description: Caller-declared reference/hash. No source fetch, signature or truth verification.
DeclaredDossierMaterialDto.title: DeclaredDossierMaterialDto

DossierCheckCoverageDto.description: Currentness of the explicitly bound check, not capability verification.
DossierCheckCoverageDto.title: DossierCheckCoverageDto

DossierCheckResultDto.description: Original terminal outcome only; observation detail belongs to the referenced check.
DossierCheckResultDto.title: DossierCheckResultDto

DossierMaterialCoverageDto.description: DECLARED remains pending source verification; EXPIRED means all entries expired.
DossierMaterialCoverageDto.title: DossierMaterialCoverageDto

DossierMaterialExpirationDto.description: NOT_DECLARED means expiry was not supplied, never permanent validity.
DossierMaterialExpirationDto.title: DossierMaterialExpirationDto

DossierMaterialRequestDto.description: Declared metadata only; references are never fetched or verified.
DossierMaterialRequestDto.title: DossierMaterialRequestDto

MaterialSourceCheckDetailDto.description:
Live source remeasurement determines currentness, without changing the historical result.

Certain binding/content changes remain STALE even if other source checks are unavailable.
Expiration is independent; missing expiration is not permanent validity.
MaterialSourceCheckDetailDto.title: MaterialSourceCheckDetailDto

MaterialSourceCheckReceiptDto.description:
Historical registration receipt only. GET detail for result/currentness.

No candidate ETag.
MaterialSourceCheckReceiptDto.title: MaterialSourceCheckReceiptDto

MaterialSourceCheckSnapshotDto.description:
Historical comparison of actual bytes against approved-copy and declared digests.

MATCHED is not source authority, semantic truth, complete Model verification or activation.
Original dossier provenance remains DECLARED. Missing measurements remain null, never zero.
snapshotHash identifies this check; dossierSnapshotHash identifies its immutable parent.
MaterialSourceCheckSnapshotDto.title: MaterialSourceCheckSnapshotDto

ModelDeploymentDto.description:
Persisted, unverified declaration.

DRAFT does not imply availability, activation or routing eligibility.
ModelDeploymentDto.title: ModelDeploymentDto

PatchModelDeploymentRequestDto.description:
Omitted fields stay unchanged; at least one editable field is required.

Only connectionRef, description and the two token declarations accept null to clear.
PatchModelDeploymentRequestDto.title: PatchModelDeploymentRequestDto

SearchQueryObservationDto.description:
Count and digest of distinct normalized Provider queries.

Original query text is absent; null metadata means the query was not returned.
SearchQueryObservationDto.title: SearchQueryObservationDto

SearchSourceObservationDto.description:
Only Provider-reported source signals, not verified pages, answer citations or quality.

One HTTP attempt may contain multiple Provider searches; counts/limits are not billing caps.
store=false covers response-session storage only, not a general zero-retention guarantee.
SearchSourceObservationDto.title: SearchSourceObservationDto

SearchSourceReferenceDto.description:
Sanitized HTTPS reference reported by this search call.

Query/fragment removed; never fetched and not a precise page snapshot.
SearchSourceReferenceDto.title: SearchSourceReferenceDto

StreamObservationDto.description:
Only local reception/closure facts.

Provider cancellation and stopped billing are unconfirmed.
StreamObservationDto.title: StreamObservationDto

ThinkingObservationDto.description:
Dedicated reasoning field observations, never reasoning text or a quality judgment.

Counts and bytes are observed protocol metadata, not token usage or cost.
ThinkingObservationDto.title: ThinkingObservationDto

ValidationDossierDetailDto.description:
Dynamic projection over immutable registration; CURRENT is not verified or routable.

Expiration and dependency changes update the opaque ETag, never snapshotHash.
ValidationDossierDetailDto.title: ValidationDossierDetailDto

ValidationDossierReceiptDto.description:
Historical registration receipt. Read detail for current projections.

No candidate write ETag.
ValidationDossierReceiptDto.title: ValidationDossierReceiptDto

ValidationDossierSnapshotDto.description: Immutable registration. snapshotHash identifies this dossier, not source authenticity.
ValidationDossierSnapshotDto.title: ValidationDossierSnapshotDto

info.description:
内部研发平台 Control Plane API。

全局约定：JSON 一律 camelCase；ID 一律 string；错误统一 application/problem+json（RFC 9457）；
分页 cursor 型 {items, nextCursor}；写并发 If-Match/ETag；变更命令 Idempotency-Key——
后三者自 V0.2 首个真实接口起强制执行。
info.title: engineering-platform-control-plane
